summary: Verdict: fail. The code facts of the spec hold: FR-0, FR-3, and FR-5 match the checker, the runner, and the CI job. One Blocker: FR-1 leaves the matching rule open, so a loose match can let one unfinished Green task pass the jr-green gate. Two Majors: the Red cases omit the `deferred` and SHA clauses, and they name no fixtures for the old-result and Lending cases. Three Nits cover wording, FR-3, and the change-set record.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] spec.md FR-1: FR-1 does not say if a name matches as a substring, as a whole word, or as the role label of the task. Define the rule. Add a Red case for near-miss text. Rationale: In Lending plans, `review a` matches 'review assignments' (lending-desk-bench measure/tracks/domain_trust/plan.md:83), and `acceptance` matches Red task 7.1 (measure/tracks/daily_model_schedule/plan.md:1126). A `[~]` Green task that says 'per the acceptance criteria' counts 1 today and 0 with a substring helper, so the gate passes in error. The bare words `adversarial` and `acceptance` already match each listed phrase form, so the intended rule is unclear.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Major] plan.md Task 1.1 and spec.md FR-2: No Red case pins the `deferred` clause or the unchanged `complete > with_sha` check. The plan needs a case where a `[~]` Review A task holds `deferred`: the gate passes, as today. It needs the same case plus an unfinished `[~]` Green task: the gate fails. It needs a case with an `[x]` task without a SHA plus a `[~]` Review A task: the gate fails with the SHA message. Rationale: A helper that skips the `deferred` check makes `incomplete` equal to -1, and the branch treats -1 as true, so a passing plan fails. The same helper lets a deferred task use the one ignore, so an unfinished Green task passes.

F3 [Major] plan.md Task 1.1: The old-result cases, the 'each named later role' case, and the Lending-shape case name no fixture or expected result. The mid-red case needs an open `[ ]` task and a `[~]` review task as the only `[~]` task; the result must not change. The review-a case needs all `[x]` tasks plus one `[~]` Review A task; the gate must still fail. State if 'each named later role' means the five names or all eleven forms. Write the Lending fixture into the plan from commit 6faaf42 of lending-desk-bench (`measure/tracks/domain_trust/plan.md`, lines 140 to 199). Rationale: A weak fixture passes even if `phase_counts` ignores the review task, and a Lending fixture needs each SHA on its marker line.

F4 [Nit] spec.md FR-1 and FR-2: FR-1 says the gate ignores exactly one task, and FR-2 says at most one. With no qualifying task, the gate ignores none. Use 'at most one' in FR-1. Rationale: 'Exactly one' can mean 'ignore only when one task qualifies', and that reading gives a different count for two tasks.

F5 [Nit] spec.md FR-3: The condition 'if other callers need it' has one answer. Mid-red (line 1293), jr-green (line 1334), and the review and phase-acceptance branch (line 1359) each unpack the five values of `phase_counts`. State that the five-value return stays. Name the code that the helper reuses: `phase_blocks` (line 371) and the task-line pattern that `phase_counts`, `track_incomplete`, and `discover_phases` repeat. Rationale: A condition hides a fixed fact, and a fourth copy of the pattern adds drift.

F6 [Nit] spec.md FR-4 and Out of Scope: Three change-set points stay open. Out of Scope names 'the other tech-debt rows', but `measure/tech-debt.md` holds no row for this track and FR-4 lists none. FR-4 omits `CHANGELOG.md`, and earlier checker gate changes (commits f68a87f, 94698fe, 7e6dc79, and 27c2ed0) each added an entry. The fix reaches Lending only after the install of `~/.agents/skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py`, which Lending runs, and the spec is silent on that step. State each decision. Rationale: The earlier spec `audit_role_gate_allow_20261123` states its install step in FR-4.
evidence: HEAD 9dad8a38bcdccaec5a8016546cbe9c9590ecd0b9 equals audited_head_sha. The working tree is clean. The branch is fix/green-gate-open-review-task.
Role rule applied: spec-review.md of the track was not read. The Author model came from the brief.

FR-0 holds: phase_counts (skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py:380-393) counts each non-[x] task without 'deferred' as incomplete, and the jr-green branch (lines 1323-1341) prints 'current phase still has N non-deferred incomplete tasks' at line 1338.

Experiment (importlib, temp folder outside the repo): a phase with two [x] tasks and one '[~] 3.5 Review A.' task gives phase_counts (3, 2, 1, 1, 2), so jr-green fails today. This reproduces the Lending failure.

Callers of phase_counts: mid-red line 1293, jr-green line 1334, and the audit branch line 1359 (review-a, review-b, review-c, phase-acceptance). Each unpacks five values. final-acceptance uses track_incomplete at line 1374.
Existing suites: no fixture in tests/spec_review_gate pairs a [~] task with a later-role word, so the change breaks no current test.

FR-5 holds: tests/spec_review_gate/run.sh discovers test_*.py with no edit. Both style files exist and use unittest with a temporary git repository. The CI job 'checks' runs bash tests/spec_review_gate/run.sh (.github/workflows/ci.yml lines 12 to 18).
gate_value reads the environment first and measure/gates.json second, so the orchestrator sets RED_TEST_COMMAND and GREEN_TEST_COMMAND. This is not a finding.
No test count or check count appears in spec.md or plan.md.

Matching corpus, read only: 7 of 126 Red and Green task lines in this repo match the FR-1 words as substrings. 22 of 516 task lines in four Lending checkouts match, among lines whose first 40 characters name no later role. Task 1.1 of this plan matches (plan.md:14).

Lending ground truth, read only: commit 6faaf42 exists in lending-desk-bench. measure/tracks/domain_trust/plan.md lines 187 to 199 show '- [~] 3.5 Review A.' and the '[b]' tasks 3.6 and 3.7 with a 'deferred:<role>' suffix. Rule A12 (lines 27 to 32) keeps exactly one [~] task while a [b] task remains.

Experiment on a simple helper (no deferred check, subtract min(1, n)): a [~] role task with 'deferred' alone gives incomplete -1 and the gate fails. The same task beside an unfinished [~] Green task makes the gate pass. A [~] Green task that says 'acceptance criteria' passes.

The installed copy ~/.agents/skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py is a separate regular file. It is identical to the repo copy today (install stamp: ref main, commit c8829046). Lending runs this copy.
CHANGELOG precedent: commits f68a87f, 94698fe, 7e6dc79, and 27c2ed0 each changed the checker and CHANGELOG.md. measure/tech-debt.md has no row for this track.

Precedent for the plan shape: measure/runs/audit_role_gate_allow_20261123/green-p1-local.log shows the jr-green gate failing on the open PR and records tasks. Task 1.3 stays open at the Green gate here too. This is a process note, not a finding.

paraphrase.proposes: This chore makes the jr-green role gate ignore one open review task, as Lending task 3.5 needs. Today the gate counts each task that is not `[x]` and has no `deferred` as incomplete. A helper, used only by the jr-green branch, ignores at most one `[~]` task whose text names `review-a`, `review-b`, `review-c`, `adversarial`, or `acceptance`. Every other gate, the SHA-evidence check, and the return shape of `phase_counts` stay unchanged. Red adds `tests/spec_review_gate/test_green_gate_review_task.py`, Green edits the checker, and the build session opens the pull request.
paraphrase.current_system: `phase_counts` in `skills/measure-orchestrator/scripts/measure_interphase_checks.py` reads one phase of `plan.md` and returns five counts: total, complete, in progress, incomplete, and complete with a SHA. A task is incomplete when it is not `[x]` and its text has no `deferred`. The jr-green branch fails with `current phase still has N non-deferred incomplete tasks` when the incomplete count is above zero. Mid-red, review-a, review-b, review-c, and phase-acceptance read the same counts, and final-acceptance uses `track_incomplete`. Lending rule A12 marks the review task `[~]` before Review A starts, so the open task 3.5 fails the jr-green gate.
